shortdesc.ph: Queries the video codec capabilities supported by the SDK.
Queries the SDK's video codec capabilities.
Queries the video codec capabilities of the SDK.

p.codeblock: virtual int queryCodecCapability(CodecCapInfo* codecInfo, int& size) = 0;

section.p: Call this method before enabling H.265 to check whether the device supports the required codec capabilities. To check H.265 hardware encoding or H.265 hardware decoding support, inspect the returned whose codecType is AgoraVideoCodecTypeH265. The codecCapMask field indicates whether hardware encoding or hardware decoding is supported, and codecCapLevels indicates the supported hardware decoding capability level.

plentry.pd: Input and output parameter representing the array of video codec capabilities supported by the SDK. You pass a array when calling this method to indicate the video codec capabilities to query. After execution, the array is filled with the actual video codec capabilities supported by the SDK. See .

Input and output parameter representing the size of the codecInfo array. You pass in the size of codecInfo when calling this method. After execution, this value is updated to the actual size of the returned codecInfo array.

pd.p: Input and output parameter. An array representing the video codec capabilities of the SDK. See .

ul.li: Input value: One defined by the user when executing this method, representing the video codec capability to be queried.
Output value: The after the method is executed, representing the actual video codec capabilities of the SDK.

section.title: Return Values
section.p: If the method call succeeds, it returns an array of , indicating the device's video encoding capabilities. If the method call times out, please modify your logic to avoid calling this method on the main thread.

ul.li: One array indicating the video encoding capability of the device, if the method call succeeds.
If the call timeouts, please modify the call logic and do not invoke the method in the main thread.
